lesson.snail_garden.title: Snail Garden
lesson.snail_garden.summary: Build a friendly snail with one flowing shell, then place it in a tiny garden and invent your own patterns and details.
lesson.snail_garden.step.shell_spiral: Start the shell with one slow curling line. Let the curve travel around itself and grow outward.
lesson.snail_garden.help.shell_hint: Begin near the middle and make the curve wider a little at a time. It does not need to be a perfect spiral.
lesson.snail_garden.complete.shell: Your looping curve already reads like a shell.
lesson.snail_garden.step.body: Now add the long soft body under the shell and two feelers near the head.
lesson.snail_garden.help.body_hint: Keep the body low and long. The feelers can point in any comfortable direction.
lesson.snail_garden.complete.body: The shell and body now connect into one clear snail.
lesson.snail_garden.step.garden: Add one leaf and one flower so the snail overlaps a simple garden instead of floating alone.
lesson.snail_garden.help.garden_hint: Place the garden marks near the snail. Let one shape sit partly behind or beside another so the scene feels connected.
lesson.snail_garden.complete.garden: Your snail now has a small place to explore.
lesson.snail_garden.step.make_yours: Make the garden yours. Try a shell pattern, grass, another flower, a pebble or any detail you imagine. These are ideas, not a checklist.
lesson.snail_garden.help.make_yours: Choose one detail that sounds fun and add it your way. You can stop whenever the picture feels finished.
lesson.snail_garden.complete.drawing: Your snail garden has its own pattern and story.
